title: B-MASTER: scalable Bayesian multivariate regression for master predictor discovery in colorectal cancer microbiome-metabolite profiles.
snippet: The gut microbiome shapes cancer therapy response through its influence on host metabolism. While prior studies examine pairwise associations between individual genera and metabolites, there is limited methodology for identifying microbial genera that systematically regulate the overall metabolome.
